0022600227.text: The Toronto Raptors (5-6, 4-6 in their last ten, on a two-game losing streak, 7th in the East) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (9-3, 7-3 in their last ten, second in the East) in the Raptors' 12th game of the season. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes (out, groin soreness), and Trayce Jackson-Davis is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), with Joel Embiid and LeBron James both day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet this season, and their last meeting came on January 12 in Toronto, where the Raptors lost 115-102.
